# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
name: OpenCode evidence PR review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      pr_head_sha:
        description: Immutable pull-request head commit to check out, execute, review, and report.
        required: true
        type: string
      model:
        description: OpenCode provider/model the reviewer runs.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free
      opencode_version:
        description: Pinned opencode-ai npm version for the review runner.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 1.18.18
      node_version:
        description: Node 22 release used by evidence, compilation and review jobs; callers can select an exact frozen patch version.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "22"
      muse_revision:
        description: Pinned octave-commons/muse commit used to compile the review observer projection.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 0b9a91492c8355e6933dc2164d35668cb76d9e60
      agents_revision:
        description: Pinned riatzukiza/.agents commit mounted as global skills.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 7fd3252e7663ad5e68be5e90429d126aa66c38c8
      setup_eta_mu_toolchain:
        description: Install Java/Clojure/pnpm/Node before gates. Callers with their own toolchain disable this and provide evidence_gates_script.
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: true
      evidence_gates_script:
        description: Bash snippet of run_gate invocations producing deterministic evidence. Runs in the checked-out pull request.
        required: false
        type: string
        default: |
          run_gate install pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          install_status="$(awk -F= '$1 == "install" {print $2}' "$statuses")"
          if [[ "$install_status" == "0" ]]; then
            run_gate bootstrap_extensions pnpm --dir packages/extensions build
            run_gate lint pnpm lint
            run_gate test pnpm test
            run_gate_preserving_generated_outputs build pnpm build
          else
            echo "bootstrap_extensions=125" >> "$statuses"
            echo "lint=125" >> "$statuses"
            echo "test=125" >> "$statuses"
            echo "build=125" >> "$statuses"
            echo "Dependency installation failed; bootstrap, lint, test, and build were not attempted." >> "$log"
          fi
    secrets:
      ETA_MU_APP_ID:
        # Optional so evidence/compile jobs still run in organizations where the
        # app secrets are not visible; the review job then fails fast with an
        # explicit operator instruction instead of a plan-time error.
        required: false
      ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY:
        required: false
      DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL:
        required: false

concurrency:
  group: opencode-evidence-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deterministic_evidence:
    name: Produce deterministic review evidence
    if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    outputs:
      result: ${{ steps.gates.outputs.result }}
      expected_sha: ${{ steps.gates.outputs.expected_sha }}
      executed_sha: ${{ steps.gates.outputs.executed_sha }}
      completion_sha: ${{ steps.gates.outputs.completion_sha }}
      exact_head: ${{ steps.gates.outputs.exact_head }}
      clean: ${{ steps.gates.outputs.clean }}
      artifact_name: ${{ steps.deterministic_artifact_name.outputs.name }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact and clean pull request checkout
        id: checkout_guard
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.opencode/review-evidence"

          event_head_sha="$EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA"
          expected_sha="$PR_HEAD_SHA"
          executed_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          checkout_status="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
          expected_commit=false
          event_head_matches=false
          exact_head=false
          clean=false
          if [[ "$expected_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$expected_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
            git cat-file -e "${expected_sha}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && expected_commit=true
          fi
          if [[ "$event_head_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$event_head_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
            [[ "$expected_sha" == "$event_head_sha" ]] && event_head_matches=true
          fi
          [[ "$expected_commit" == true && "$event_head_matches" == true && "$executed_sha" == "$expected_sha" ]] && exact_head=true
          [[ -z "$checkout_status" ]] && clean=true

          {
            echo "event_head_sha=$event_head_sha"
            echo "expected_sha=$expected_sha"
            echo "executed_sha=$executed_sha"
            echo "expected_commit=$expected_commit"
            echo "event_head_matches=$event_head_matches"
            echo "exact_head=$exact_head"
            echo "clean=$clean"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
          printf '%s\n' "$checkout_status" > "$evidence_dir/checkout-status.txt"
          jq -n \
            --arg event_head_sha "$event_head_sha" \
            --arg expected_sha "$expected_sha" \
            --arg executed_sha "$executed_sha" \
            --argjson expected_commit "$expected_commit" \
            --argjson event_head_matches "$event_head_matches" \
            --argjson exact_head "$exact_head" \
            --argjson clean "$clean" \
            '{event_head_sha: $event_head_sha, expected_sha: $expected_sha, executed_sha: $executed_sha, expected_commit: $expected_commit, event_head_matches: $event_head_matches, exact_head: $exact_head, clean: $clean}' \
            > "$evidence_dir/checkout.json"

          if [[ "$expected_commit" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected pull-request revision is not an available immutable commit: $expected_sha"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$event_head_matches" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Caller-selected pull-request head $expected_sha does not match event head $event_head_sha."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$exact_head" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected pull-request head $expected_sha but checkout executed $executed_sha."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$clean" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Pull-request checkout was dirty before deterministic execution."
            printf '%s\n' "$checkout_status"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Set up Java 21
        if: ${{ !contains(toJSON(inputs), '"setup_eta_mu_toolchain"') || inputs.setup_eta_mu_toolchain }}
        uses: actions/setup-java@cf277c60eb25467037889841efdb72551f06f6c3 # v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Set up Clojure CLI 1.12.5.1654
        if: ${{ !contains(toJSON(inputs), '"setup_eta_mu_toolchain"') || inputs.setup_eta_mu_toolchain }}
        uses: DeLaGuardo/setup-clojure@ada62bb3282a01a296659d48378b812b8e097360 # 13.4
        with:
          cli: 1.12.5.1654
          bb: "1.13.219"
          clj-kondo: "2025.10.23"

      - name: Set up pnpm 10.14.0
        if: ${{ !contains(toJSON(inputs), '"setup_eta_mu_toolchain"') || inputs.setup_eta_mu_toolchain }}
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@b906affcce14559ad1aafd4ab0e942779e9f58b1 # v4
        with:
          version: "10.14.0"
          run_install: false

      - name: Set up Node 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ inputs.node_version || '22' }}

      - name: Detect eta-mu app credentials
        id: dependency-credentials
        if: ${{ !contains(toJSON(inputs), '"setup_eta_mu_toolchain"') || inputs.setup_eta_mu_toolchain }}
        env:
          ETA_MU_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_ID }}
          ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [[ -n "${ETA_MU_APP_ID}" && -n "${ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY}" ]]; then
            echo "available=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "available=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Create cross-repository read token
        id: dependency-token
        if: ${{ steps.dependency-credentials.outputs.available == 'true' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@d72941d797fd3113feb6b93fd0dec494b13a2547 # v1.12.0
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: |
            katamorph
          permission-contents: read

      - name: Mirror private Git dependencies
        if: ${{ steps.dependency-token.outputs.token != '' }}
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          DEPENDENCY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.dependency-token.outputs.token }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mirrors="$RUNNER_TEMP/private-git-mirrors"
          mkdir -p "$mirrors"
          authorization="$(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$DEPENDENCY_TOKEN" | base64 -w0)"

          mirror_repository() {
            local repository="$1"
            local destination="$mirrors/${repository}.git"
            local attempt
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              rm -rf "$destination"
              if git -c "http.https://github.com/.extraheader=AUTHORIZATION: basic ${authorization}" \
                clone --mirror \
                "https://github.com/open-hax/${repository}.git" \
                "$destination"; then
                return 0
              fi
              if [[ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]]; then
                return 1
              fi
              sleep $((attempt * 5))
            done
          }

          mirror_repository katamorph

      - name: Stage pull request diff and context
        if: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.exact_head == 'true' && steps.checkout_guard.outputs.clean == 'true' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.opencode/review-evidence"
          mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"

          [[ "$PR_BASE_SHA" =~ ^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$ ]]
          [[ "$PR_HEAD_SHA" =~ ^([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$ ]]
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PR_HEAD_SHA"
          test "$(jq -r '.pull_request.head.sha' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")" = "$PR_HEAD_SHA"
          test "$(jq -r '.pull_request.base.sha' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")" = "$PR_BASE_SHA"
          diff_base_sha="$(git merge-base "$PR_BASE_SHA" "$PR_HEAD_SHA")"
          git diff --no-ext-diff --find-renames "$diff_base_sha" "$PR_HEAD_SHA" > "$evidence_dir/basehead.diff"
          bytes="$(wc -c < "$evidence_dir/basehead.diff")"
          digest="$(sha256sum "$evidence_dir/basehead.diff" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
          cp "$evidence_dir/basehead.diff" "$evidence_dir/pr.diff"
          truncated=false
          if [[ "$bytes" -gt 300000 ]]; then
            head -c 300000 "$evidence_dir/basehead.diff" > "$evidence_dir/pr.diff"
            printf '\n[eta-mu review] diff truncated at 300000 bytes (was %s).\n' "$bytes" >> "$evidence_dir/pr.diff"
            truncated=true
          fi
          jq -n \
            --arg base "$PR_BASE_SHA" --arg head "$PR_HEAD_SHA" --arg diff_base "$diff_base_sha" \
            --arg digest "$digest" --argjson bytes "$bytes" --argjson truncated "$truncated" \
            --arg repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-}" --arg number "$(jq -r '.pull_request.number' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")" \
            --arg run_id "${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}" --arg run_attempt "${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-}" \
            --arg workflow_sha "${GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA:-}" --arg workflow_ref "${GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF:-}" \
            '{schema: "open-hax.review-input/v1", base_sha: $base, head_sha: $head, diff_base_sha: $diff_base,
              full_diff: {path: "basehead.diff", bytes: $bytes, sha256: $digest},
              preview: {path: "pr.diff", limit_bytes: 300000, truncated: $truncated},
              provenance: {repository: $repository, pull_request: $number, run_id: $run_id,
                run_attempt: $run_attempt, workflow_sha: $workflow_sha, workflow_ref: $workflow_ref}}' \
            > "$evidence_dir/input-manifest.json"

          jq -r '
            "# Pull request context",
            "",
            "- Number: #\(.pull_request.number)",
            "- Title: \(.pull_request.title)",
            "- Author: \(.pull_request.user.login)",
            "- Branches: \(.pull_request.head.ref) -> \(.pull_request.base.ref)",
            "- Head SHA: \(.pull_request.head.sha)",
            "- Draft: \(.pull_request.draft)",
            "",
            "## Body",
            "",
            (.pull_request.body // "(no body)")
          ' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" > "$evidence_dir/pr-context.md"

      - name: Run deterministic gates
        id: gate_commands
        if: ${{ always() }}
        continue-on-error: true
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          EVIDENCE_GATES_SCRIPT: ${{ inputs.evidence_gates_script || '' }}
          CHECKOUT_EXACT_HEAD: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.exact_head }}
          CHECKOUT_CLEAN: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.clean }}
        run: |
          set +e
          evidence_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.opencode/review-evidence"
          log="$evidence_dir/deterministic.log"
          statuses="$evidence_dir/statuses.env"
          mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"

          run_gate() {
            local name="$1"
            shift
            {
              echo
              echo "===== ${name} ====="
              printf 'command:'
              printf ' %q' "$@"
              echo
            } >> "$log"
            "$@" >> "$log" 2>&1
            local code=$?
            echo "${name}=${code}" >> "$statuses"
            echo "${name}: exit ${code}" | tee -a "$log"
            return 0
          }

          run_gate_preserving_generated_outputs() {
            local name="$1"
            shift
            local baseline_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-generated-output-baseline"
            local generated_dir="$evidence_dir/generated"
            local baseline_clean=true
            local generated_paths=(
              "packages/legacy/ai/src/models.generated.ts"
              "packages/contracts/output/dist-cli/index.cjs"
              "packages/contracts/output/dist-cli/index.cjs.map"
            )
            local generated_path snapshot_path artifact_path

            mkdir -p "$baseline_dir"
            for generated_path in "${generated_paths[@]}"; do
              snapshot_path="$baseline_dir/$generated_path"
              if [[ -f "$generated_path" ]] && git diff --quiet HEAD -- "$generated_path"; then
                mkdir -p "$(dirname "$snapshot_path")"
                cp "$generated_path" "$snapshot_path"
              else
                baseline_clean=false
                echo "Generated output was missing or dirty before the build gate: $generated_path" >> "$log"
              fi
            done
            if [[ "$baseline_clean" == true ]]; then
              echo "generated_outputs_baseline=0" >> "$statuses"
            else
              echo "generated_outputs_baseline=1" >> "$statuses"
            fi

            run_gate "$name" "$@"

            if [[ "$baseline_clean" == true ]]; then
              for generated_path in "${generated_paths[@]}"; do
                snapshot_path="$baseline_dir/$generated_path"
                artifact_path="$generated_dir/$generated_path"
                if [[ ! -f "$generated_path" ]] || ! cmp -s "$snapshot_path" "$generated_path"; then
                  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$artifact_path")"
                  if [[ -f "$generated_path" ]]; then
                    cp "$generated_path" "$artifact_path"
                    sha256sum "$artifact_path" > "${artifact_path}.sha256"
                  else
                    printf '%s\n' "build removed $generated_path" > "${artifact_path}.missing"
                  fi
                fi
              done

              for generated_path in "${generated_paths[@]}"; do
                snapshot_path="$baseline_dir/$generated_path"
                mkdir -p "$(dirname "$generated_path")"
                cp "$snapshot_path" "$generated_path"
              done
              if git diff --quiet HEAD -- "${generated_paths[@]}"; then
                echo "generated_outputs_restore=0" >> "$statuses"
              else
                echo "generated_outputs_restore=1" >> "$statuses"
                echo "Explicit generated outputs could not be restored to the checked-out revision." >> "$log"
              fi
            else
              echo "generated_outputs_restore=125" >> "$statuses"
            fi
          }

          mirrors="$RUNNER_TEMP/private-git-mirrors"
          remove_mirror_rewrites() {
            git config --global --unset-all \
              "url.file://$mirrors/katamorph.git.insteadOf" || true
          }
          trap remove_mirror_rewrites EXIT

          if [[ -d "$mirrors/katamorph.git" ]]; then
            git config --global \
              "url.file://$mirrors/katamorph.git.insteadOf" \
              "https://github.com/open-hax/katamorph.git"
          fi

          if [[ "$CHECKOUT_EXACT_HEAD" != "true" || "$CHECKOUT_CLEAN" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "checkout_guard=1" >> "$statuses"
            echo "Deterministic commands were not executed because the checkout was not the exact clean pull-request head." >> "$log"
          elif [[ -n "${EVIDENCE_GATES_SCRIPT//[[:space:]]/}" ]]; then
            eval "$EVIDENCE_GATES_SCRIPT"
          else
            run_gate install pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
            install_status="$(awk -F= '$1 == "install" {print $2}' "$statuses")"
            if [[ "$install_status" == "0" ]]; then
              run_gate bootstrap_extensions pnpm --dir packages/extensions build
              run_gate lint pnpm lint
              run_gate test pnpm test
              run_gate_preserving_generated_outputs build pnpm build
            else
              {
                echo "bootstrap_extensions=125"
                echo "lint=125"
                echo "test=125"
                echo "build=125"
              } >> "$statuses"
              echo "Dependency installation failed; bootstrap, lint, test, and build were not attempted." >> "$log"
            fi
          fi

      - name: Summarize deterministic evidence
        id: gates
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          CHECKOUT_EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.expected_sha }}
          CHECKOUT_EXECUTED_SHA: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.executed_sha }}
          CHECKOUT_EXACT_HEAD: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.exact_head }}
          CHECKOUT_CLEAN: ${{ steps.checkout_guard.outputs.clean }}
          GATE_STEP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.gate_commands.outcome }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          evidence_dir="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.opencode/review-evidence"
          mkdir -p "$evidence_dir"
          completion_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)"
          completion_status="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | grep -v -e '^?? \.opencode/review-evidence/' || true)"
          completion_clean=false
          [[ -z "$completion_status" ]] && completion_clean=true
          printf '%s\n' "$completion_status" > "$evidence_dir/completion-status.txt"
          export COMPLETION_SHA="$completion_sha"
          export COMPLETION_CLEAN="$completion_clean"

          node <<'NODE'
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          const path = require('node:path');
          const evidenceDir = path.join(process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE, '.opencode', 'review-evidence');
          const statusesPath = path.join(evidenceDir, 'statuses.env');
          const errors = [];
          const statuses = {};
          if (!fs.existsSync(statusesPath)) {
            errors.push('deterministic statuses.env is missing');
          } else {
            for (const line of fs.readFileSync(statusesPath, 'utf8').trim().split(/\n+/).filter(Boolean)) {
              const match = /^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)=([0-9]+)$/.exec(line);
              if (!match) {
                errors.push(`malformed deterministic status: ${line}`);
                continue;
              }
              const [, name, rawCode] = match;
              if (Object.hasOwn(statuses, name)) {
                errors.push(`duplicate deterministic status: ${name}`);
                continue;
              }
              statuses[name] = Number(rawCode);
            }
          }
          if (Object.keys(statuses).length === 0) {
            errors.push('no deterministic gate statuses were recorded');
          }
          const attempted = Object.fromEntries(
            Object.entries(statuses).map(([name, code]) => [name, code !== 125]),
          );
          const shaPattern = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i;
          const expectedHeadSha = process.env.CHECKOUT_EXPECTED_SHA || process.env.PR_HEAD_SHA || '';
          const executedSha = process.env.CHECKOUT_EXECUTED_SHA || '';
          const completionSha = process.env.COMPLETION_SHA || '';
          const exactHead = shaPattern.test(expectedHeadSha)
            && shaPattern.test(executedSha)
            && shaPattern.test(completionSha)
            && expectedHeadSha === executedSha
            && expectedHeadSha === completionSha
            && process.env.CHECKOUT_EXACT_HEAD === 'true';
          const clean = process.env.CHECKOUT_CLEAN === 'true' && process.env.COMPLETION_CLEAN === 'true';
          if (!exactHead) errors.push('expected, executed, and completion revisions are not one exact pull-request head');
          if (!clean) errors.push('checkout was not clean across deterministic execution');
          if (process.env.GATE_STEP_OUTCOME !== 'success') {
            errors.push(`deterministic command step outcome was ${process.env.GATE_STEP_OUTCOME || 'missing'}`);
          }
          const result = errors.length === 0 && Object.values(statuses).every((code) => code === 0)
            ? 'success'
            : 'failure';
          const summary = {
            schema: 'open-hax.review-evidence/v2',
            repository: process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY,
            pull_request: Number(process.env.PR_NUMBER),
            base_sha: process.env.PR_BASE_SHA,
            expected_head_sha: expectedHeadSha,
            executed_sha: executedSha || null,
            completion_sha: completionSha || null,
            head_sha: exactHead ? executedSha : null,
            exact_head: exactHead,
            clean_checkout: clean,
            generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
            result,
            statuses,
            attempted,
            errors,
            interpretation: 'Exit 125 means the gate was skipped because a required prerequisite failed.',
          };
          fs.writeFileSync(path.join(evidenceDir, 'summary.json'), `${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`);
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `result=${result}\n`);
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `expected_sha=${expectedHeadSha}\n`);
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `executed_sha=${executedSha}\n`);
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `completion_sha=${completionSha}\n`);
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `exact_head=${exactHead}\n`);
          fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `clean=${clean}\n`);
          NODE

      - name: Bind deterministic artifact name
        id: deterministic_artifact_name
        if: always()
        shell: bash
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}

        with:

          const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.opencode/opencode.json', 'utf8'));
          const permissionNames = Object.keys(config.permission ?? {}).sort();
          if (JSON.stringify(permissionNames) !== JSON.stringify(expected)) {

    name: Review pull request with OpenCode MiMo
    needs: [deterministic_evidence, prepare_review_context]
    if: ${{ always() && needs.deterministic_evidence.result == 'success' && needs.prepare_review_context.result == 'success' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    outputs:
      expected_sha: ${{ steps.review_completion.outputs.expected_sha }}
      executed_sha: ${{ steps.review_completion.outputs.executed_sha }}
      completion_sha: ${{ steps.review_completion.outputs.completion_sha }}
      exact_head: ${{ steps.review_completion.outputs.exact_head }}
      clean: ${{ steps.review_completion.outputs.clean }}
    env:
      HAS_DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL != '' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact and clean review checkout
        id: review_checkout
        shell: bash
        env:
          EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          event_head_sha="$EVENT_PR_HEAD_SHA"
          expected_sha="$PR_HEAD_SHA"
          executed_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          checkout_status="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
          expected_commit=false
          event_head_matches=false
          exact_head=false
          clean=false
          if [[ "$expected_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$expected_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
            git cat-file -e "${expected_sha}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && expected_commit=true
          fi
          if [[ "$event_head_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ || "$event_head_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
            [[ "$expected_sha" == "$event_head_sha" ]] && event_head_matches=true
          fi
          [[ "$expected_commit" == true && "$event_head_matches" == true && "$executed_sha" == "$expected_sha" ]] && exact_head=true
          [[ -z "$checkout_status" ]] && clean=true
          {
            echo "event_head_sha=$event_head_sha"
            echo "expected_sha=$expected_sha"
            echo "executed_sha=$executed_sha"
            echo "expected_commit=$expected_commit"
            echo "event_head_matches=$event_head_matches"
            echo "exact_head=$exact_head"
            echo "clean=$clean"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$expected_commit" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected review revision is not an available immutable commit: $expected_sha"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$event_head_matches" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Caller-selected review head $expected_sha does not match event head $event_head_sha."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$exact_head" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Expected pull-request head $expected_sha but review checkout executed $executed_sha."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$clean" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Pull-request checkout was dirty before review execution."
            printf '%s\n' "$checkout_status"

          assert.ok(downloaded.equals(expected), 'Downloaded full diff differs from independent Git input');
          const preview = truncated ? Buffer.concat([expected.subarray(0, 300000),
            Buffer.from(`\n[eta-mu review] diff truncated at 300000 bytes (was ${expected.length}).\n`)]) : expected;
          assert.ok(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'pr.diff')).equals(preview), 'Preview differs from independent Git input');
          const text = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(expected);
          const proof = {
            schema: 'open-hax.review-input-verification/v1', input_verified: true,
            verification_stage: 'fresh-review-job-before-model', base_sha: env.PR_BASE_SHA,
            head_sha: env.PR_HEAD_SHA, diff_base_sha: env.REVIEW_INPUT_DIFF_BASE_SHA,
            full_diff: fullDiff, manifest_sha256: sha256(manifestBytes), provenance,
            evidence_artifact_name: env.REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_NAME,
            verification_provenance: verificationProvenance,
          };
          if (env.REVIEW_INPUT_PHASE === 'fresh') {
            const bytes = Buffer.from(`${JSON.stringify(proof, null, 2)}\n`);
            fs.writeFileSync(proofFile, bytes);
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `input_verification_sha256=${sha256(bytes)}\n`);
          } else {
            // These digests came from completed pre-model steps, outside the
            // writable evidence/context trees. Never trust a replaced receipt.
            assert.match(env.REVIEW_INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256 || '', /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, 'Missing trusted input receipt digest');
            const proofBytes = fs.readFileSync(proofFile);
            assert.equal(sha256(proofBytes), env.REVIEW_INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256, 'Original input receipt changed after model/recovery');
            assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(proofBytes.toString('utf8')), proof, 'Input/provenance changed after initial verification');
            const contextDir = path.join(env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE, '.review-context');
            assert.match(env.REVIEW_CONTEXT_SHA256 || '', /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, 'Missing trusted review context digest');
            assert.equal(sha256(fs.readFileSync(path.join(contextDir, 'SHA256SUMS'))), env.REVIEW_CONTEXT_SHA256, 'Review context checksum list changed');
            execFileSync('sha256sum', ['--check', '--strict', 'SHA256SUMS'], { cwd: contextDir, stdio: 'inherit' });

            const submissionBytes = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir, 'submission.json'));
            const submission = JSON.parse(submissionBytes.toString('utf8'));
            // Consume Muse0b's serialized tool envelope. This is transport
            // closure, not another review state machine or cognitive proof.
            assert.deepEqual(submission['input-source'], manifest, 'Submission input identity differs from independently verified input');
            const assessments = submission['input-assessments'];
            assert.ok(Array.isArray(assessments), 'Missing tool-written input assessments');
            const chunks = assessments.length;
            assert.deepEqual(submission['input-coverage'], { chunks, delivered: chunks, assessed: chunks, missing: [] }, 'Submission full-input coverage is incomplete');
            let cursor = 0;
            for (const [index, assessment] of assessments.entries()) {
              assert.ok(assessment && assessment.id === index + 1, 'Missing or duplicate assessment identity');
              assert.ok(Number.isInteger(assessment.start) && Number.isInteger(assessment.end)
                && assessment.start === cursor && assessment.end > cursor && assessment.end <= text.length,
                'Assessment intervals do not cover the verified UTF-16 input');
              assert.ok(typeof assessment.note === 'string' && assessment.note.trim().length > 0, 'Missing substantive assessment note');
              cursor = assessment.end;
            }
            assert.equal(cursor, text.length, 'Submission omits verified full-input ranges');

            // Publication consumes these exact validated bytes, never a later
            // reread of the model-writable evidence file. No metadata is added.
            const frozenDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'opencode-verified-submission-'));
            const frozenFile = path.join(frozenDir, 'submission.json');
            fs.writeFileSync(frozenFile, submissionBytes, { mode: 0o400 });
            const submissionSha256 = sha256(submissionBytes);
            fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'submission-verification.json'), `${JSON.stringify({
              ...proof, schema: 'open-hax.review-submission-verification/v1',
              verification_stage: 'after-review-and-recovery-before-publication',
              input_verification_sha256: env.REVIEW_INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256,
              context_sha256: env.REVIEW_CONTEXT_SHA256, submission_sha256: submissionSha256,
              input_coverage: submission['input-coverage'],
            }, null, 2)}\n`);
            fs.appendFileSync(env.GITHUB_OUTPUT, `submission_file=${frozenFile}\nsubmission_sha256=${submissionSha256}\n`);
            console.log(`Bound unchanged tool submission (${submissionSha256}) to complete verified input.`);
          }
          console.log(`Verified ${expected.length} full-input bytes against independent Git input (${digest}).`);
          NODE

      - name: Download Muse tools and global skills
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: ${{ needs.prepare_review_context.outputs.artifact_name }}
          path: .review-context

      - name: Verify and install the bounded review context
        id: review_context
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd .review-context && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
          echo "context_sha256=$(sha256sum .review-context/SHA256SUMS | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          # Install into the runner-global opencode config. Caller repositories
          # may track their own .opencode/ tree; nothing in this step may write
          # there. The runner is disposable, so the global config is ours.
          GLOBAL_CFG="$HOME/.config/opencode"
          RUNTIME="$HOME/.eta-mu-review"
          rm -rf "$RUNTIME" "$GLOBAL_CFG/plugins/eta-mu-actors.js" "$GLOBAL_CFG/agents/github-reviewer.md"
          mkdir -p "$GLOBAL_CFG/plugins" "$GLOBAL_CFG/agents" "$RUNTIME"

          cp -a .review-context/muse/opencode/dist "$RUNTIME/"
          cp .review-context/muse/opencode/package.json "$RUNTIME/package.json"
          npm install --prefix "$RUNTIME" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund

          printf '// Generated by the eta-mu evidence review workflow; runner-local.\nexport { EtaMuActorsPlugin } from "%s/dist/eta-mu-actors.js";\n' "$RUNTIME" \
            > "$GLOBAL_CFG/plugins/eta-mu-actors.js"
          cp .review-context/muse/opencode/agents/github-reviewer.md "$GLOBAL_CFG/agents/github-reviewer.md"
          cp .review-context/muse/opencode/opencode.json "$GLOBAL_CFG/opencode.json"

          rm -rf "$HOME/.agents"
          ln -s "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.review-context/agents" "$HOME/.agents"
          test -s "$HOME/.agents/skills/work-cycle/SKILL.md"
          test -s "$GLOBAL_CFG/agents/github-reviewer.md"
          test -s "$GLOBAL_CFG/plugins/eta-mu-actors.js"
          test -s "$GLOBAL_CFG/opencode.json"
          test -s .review-context/machinery/publish-opencode-review.cjs
          test -s .review-context/machinery/evidence-review.md

          # The reviewer must read the PR's tree, not a tree its own setup edited.
          # This counts untracked files too, deliberately: an unexpected file can
          # steer a review as easily as a modified one. The only tolerated entries
          # are deterministic evidence and the review context this step installs
          # (.opencode/review-evidence/, .review-context/), which caller
          # repositories are not required to gitignore.
          if git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all \
            | grep -v -e '^?? \.opencode/review-evidence/' -e '^?? \.review-context/' \
            | grep -q .; then
            echo "::error::Review-context setup left the working tree dirty before model execution."
            git status --short
            exit 1
          fi

          skill_count="$(find "$HOME/.agents/skills" -name SKILL.md -type f | wc -l)"
          echo "Loaded ${skill_count} global skills from riatzukiza/.agents."
          echo "Muse observer registry:"
          cat .review-context/metadata/exposed-tools.txt

      - name: Test deterministic review publisher
        run: node --test .review-context/machinery/publish-opencode-review.test.cjs

      - name: Require eta-mu app credentials
        shell: bash
        env:
          ETA_MU_APP_ID: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_ID }}
          ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [[ -z "$ETA_MU_APP_ID" || -z "$ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY" ]]; then
            echo "::error::ETA_MU_APP_ID / ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY are not visible to this repository."
            echo "::error::Operator action required: create the eta-mu GitHub App credentials as organization secrets with access to this repository, then re-run this workflow."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install pinned OpenCode CLI
        run: npm install --global opencode-ai@${{ inputs.opencode_version || '1.18.18' }}

      - name: Capture review start time
        id: review_start
        run: echo "started_at=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run bounded evidence-first OpenCode review
        env:
          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          REVIEW_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model || 'opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free' }}
          REVIEW_PROMPT_FILE: .review-context/machinery/evidence-review.md
          REVIEW_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.opencode/review-evidence
        run: node .review-context/machinery/run-opencode-review-recovery.mjs

      - name: Reverify full input and bind final submission
        id: final_review_input
        shell: bash
        env:
          REVIEW_INPUT_PHASE: final
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ inputs.pr_head_sha || github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ARTIFACT_NAME: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.artifact_name }}
          REVIEW_INPUT_VERIFICATION_SHA256: ${{ steps.review_input.outputs.input_verification_sha256 }}
          REVIEW_CONTEXT_SHA256: ${{ steps.review_context.outputs.context_sha256 }}
        run: *verify_review_input

      - name: Validate final review submission
        uses: actions/github-script@f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b # v7
        env:
          REVIEW_SUBMISSION_FILE: ${{ steps.final_review_input.outputs.submission_file }}
        with:
          script: |
            const {
              readSubmission,
              changedLineIndex,
              validateEnvelope,
            } = require('./.review-context/machinery/publish-opencode-review.cjs');
            const envelope = readSubmission({ submissionFile: process.env.REVIEW_SUBMISSION_FILE });
            const changedLines = await changedLineIndex({ github, context });
            validateEnvelope(envelope, changedLines);
            core.info('Final review submission is schema-valid and bound to reviewable pull-request lines.');

      - name: Upload review attempt artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: review-attempt-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            .opencode/review-evidence/input-verification.json
            .opencode/review-evidence/submission-verification.json
            .opencode/review-evidence/model-response-attempt-1.txt
            .opencode/review-evidence/model-response-attempt-2.txt
            .opencode/review-evidence/opencode-stderr-attempt-1.log
            .opencode/review-evidence/opencode-stderr-attempt-2.log
            .opencode/review-evidence/recovery.json
            .opencode/review-evidence/submission.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Verify review remained revision-bound
        id: review_completion
        if: ${{ always() }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ steps.review_checkout.outputs.expected_sha }}
          EXECUTED_SHA: ${{ steps.review_checkout.outputs.executed_sha }}
          INITIAL_EXACT_HEAD: ${{ steps.review_checkout.outputs.exact_head }}
          INITIAL_CLEAN: ${{ steps.review_checkout.outputs.clean }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          completion_sha="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          unexpected_status="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all \
            | grep -v -e '^?? \.opencode/review-evidence/' -e '^?? \.review-context/' || true)"
          exact_head=false
          clean=false
          if [[ "$INITIAL_EXACT_HEAD" == true && "$EXPECTED_SHA" == "$EXECUTED_SHA" && "$EXPECTED_SHA" == "$completion_sha" ]]; then
            exact_head=true
          fi
          if [[ "$INITIAL_CLEAN" == true && -z "$unexpected_status" ]]; then
            clean=true
          fi
          {
            echo "expected_sha=$EXPECTED_SHA"
            echo "executed_sha=$EXECUTED_SHA"
            echo "completion_sha=$completion_sha"
            echo "exact_head=$exact_head"
            echo "clean=$clean"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [[ "$exact_head" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Review execution moved away from exact pull-request head $EXPECTED_SHA."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$clean" != true ]]; then
            echo "::error::Review execution modified the pull-request tree."
            printf '%s\n' "$unexpected_status"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create eta-mu GitHub App token for review publication
        id: eta_mu_publish_token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.ETA_MU_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-metadata: read
          permission-pull-requests: write

      - name: Publish actual GitHub pull request review
        uses: actions/github-script@f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b # v7
        env:
          REVIEW_SUBMISSION_FILE: ${{ steps.final_review_input.outputs.submission_file }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.eta_mu_publish_token.outputs.token }}
          script: |
            const { publishReview } = require('./.review-context/machinery/publish-opencode-review.cjs');
            await publishReview({
              github,
              context,
              core,
              submissionFile: process.env.REVIEW_SUBMISSION_FILE,
            });

      - name: Send new inline review comments to Discord
        if: ${{ always() && env.HAS_DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL == 'true' }}
        uses: actions/github-script@f28e40c7f34bde8b3046d885e986cb6290c5673b # v7
        env:
          DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          REVIEW_STARTED_AT: ${{ steps.review_start.outputs.started_at }}
        with:
          github-token: ${{ steps.eta_mu_publish_token.outputs.token || github.token }}
          script: |
            const webhookUrl = process.env.DISCORD_REVIEW_WEBHOOK_URL;
            const startedAt = new Date(process.env.REVIEW_STARTED_AT || 0);
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const pr = context.payload.pull_request;
            if (!webhookUrl || !pr) return;

            const comments = await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.listReviewComments, {
              owner,
              repo,
              pull_number: pr.number,
              per_page: 100,
            });
            const fresh = comments
              .filter((comment) => new Date(comment.created_at) >= startedAt)
              .sort((a, b) => new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at));
            if (fresh.length === 0) {
              core.info('No new inline review comments to send to Discord.');
              return;
            }

            const truncate = (value, max) => {
              const text = String(value || '');
              return text.length <= max ? text : `${text.slice(0, max - 1)}…`;
            };
            const embeds = fresh.map((comment) => ({
              // Keep individual fields bounded; the message-wide limit is
              // enforced separately when batching these embeds below.
              title: truncate(`${owner}/${repo}#${pr.number}: evidence review comment`, 256),
              url: comment.html_url,
              color: 0x8b5cf6,
              description: truncate(comment.body, 1500),
              fields: [
                { name: 'Author', value: truncate(comment.user?.login || 'unknown', 100), inline: true },
                { name: 'File', value: truncate(comment.path || 'unknown', 200), inline: true },
                { name: 'Line', value: String(comment.line || comment.original_line || 'n/a'), inline: true },
                { name: 'PR', value: truncate(pr.html_url, 200), inline: false },
              ],
              timestamp: comment.created_at,
            }));

            const batches = [];
            let batch = [];
            let batchSize = 0;
            for (const embed of embeds) {
              // UTF-16 length conservatively counts Unicode text. Discord's
              // 6000-character limit includes all text across every embed.
              const size = [embed.title, embed.description, embed.author?.name, embed.footer?.text,
                ...embed.fields.flatMap((field) => [field.name, field.value])]
                .reduce((total, value) => total + String(value || '').length, 0);
              if (size > 6000) throw new Error('Discord review embed exceeds the 6000-character limit');
              if (batch.length && (batch.length === 10 || batchSize + size > 6000)) {
                batches.push(batch);
                batch = [];
                batchSize = 0;
              }
              batch.push(embed);
              batchSize += size;
            }
            if (batch.length) batches.push(batch);

            for (const chunk of batches) {
              const response = await fetch(webhookUrl, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({
                  username: 'MiMo Evidence Review',
                  content: `New evidence-backed review comment${chunk.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} on ${owner}/${repo}#${pr.number}`,
                  embeds: chunk,
                  allowed_mentions: { parse: [] },
                }),
              });
              if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(`Discord webhook failed: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`);
              }
            }

  review_gate:
    name: OpenCode evidence review gate
    needs: [deterministic_evidence, prepare_review_context, review]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Enforce truthful reusable review result
        shell: bash
        env:
          PULL_REQUEST_EVENT: ${{ github.event.pull_request != null }}
          ELIGIBLE_REVIEW_EVENT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
          DETERMINISTIC_JOB_RESULT: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.result }}
          DETERMINISTIC_OUTPUT_RESULT: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.result }}
          DETERMINISTIC_EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.expected_sha }}
          DETERMINISTIC_EXECUTED_SHA: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.executed_sha }}
          DETERMINISTIC_COMPLETION_SHA: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.completion_sha }}
          DETERMINISTIC_EXACT_HEAD: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.exact_head }}
          DETERMINISTIC_CLEAN: ${{ needs.deterministic_evidence.outputs.clean }}
          CONTEXT_JOB_RESULT: ${{ needs.prepare_review_context.result }}
          REVIEW_JOB_RESULT: ${{ needs.review.result }}
          REVIEW_EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ needs.review.outputs.expected_sha }}
          REVIEW_EXECUTED_SHA: ${{ needs.review.outputs.executed_sha }}
          REVIEW_COMPLETION_SHA: ${{ needs.review.outputs.completion_sha }}
          REVIEW_EXACT_HEAD: ${{ needs.review.outputs.exact_head }}
          REVIEW_CLEAN: ${{ needs.review.outputs.clean }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node <<'NODE'
          if (process.env.PULL_REQUEST_EVENT !== 'true') {
            console.error('::error::OpenCode evidence review gate: pull_request_context=missing');
            process.exit(1);
          }
          if (process.env.ELIGIBLE_REVIEW_EVENT !== 'true') {
            console.log('OpenCode evidence review gate is not applicable to draft or fork pull requests.');
            process.exit(0);
          }

          const failures = [];
          const requiredSuccess = {
            deterministic_job: process.env.DETERMINISTIC_JOB_RESULT,
            deterministic_output: process.env.DETERMINISTIC_OUTPUT_RESULT,
            context_job: process.env.CONTEXT_JOB_RESULT,
            review_job: process.env.REVIEW_JOB_RESULT,
          };
          for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(requiredSuccess)) {
            if (value !== 'success') failures.push(`${name}=${value || 'missing'}`);
          }

          const shaPattern = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/i;
          const revisions = [
            ['deterministic', process.env.DETERMINISTIC_EXPECTED_SHA, process.env.DETERMINISTIC_EXECUTED_SHA, process.env.DETERMINISTIC_COMPLETION_SHA],
            ['review', process.env.REVIEW_EXPECTED_SHA, process.env.REVIEW_EXECUTED_SHA, process.env.REVIEW_COMPLETION_SHA],
          ];
          for (const [name, expected, executed, completion] of revisions) {
            if (![expected, executed, completion].every((sha) => shaPattern.test(sha || ''))
                || expected !== executed
                || expected !== completion) {
              failures.push(`${name}_revision_binding=invalid`);
            }
          }
          if (process.env.DETERMINISTIC_EXACT_HEAD !== 'true') failures.push('deterministic_exact_head=false_or_missing');
          if (process.env.DETERMINISTIC_CLEAN !== 'true') failures.push('deterministic_clean=false_or_missing');
          if (process.env.REVIEW_EXACT_HEAD !== 'true') failures.push('review_exact_head=false_or_missing');
          if (process.env.REVIEW_CLEAN !== 'true') failures.push('review_clean=false_or_missing');

          if (failures.length > 0) {
            for (const failure of failures) console.error(`::error::OpenCode evidence review gate: ${failure}`);
            process.exit(1);
          }
          console.log('OpenCode evidence review gate passed with successful dependencies and exact clean revision binding.');
          NODE
